newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 99,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 99,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 99,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in three 33,000-tonne shipments on Thursday, traders said.
The shipments contain Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW) and Sprint Wheat (SW), all slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

The milling association placed the tender on behalf of several major wheat buying companies, including Tai Yu Products, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed and Lien Hwa Industry, as well as other wheat millers.
All three shipments were bought on a cost-and-freight basis at US$19.78 per tonne, traders said.
